claude.reason: The chart shows SPSC has made three prior breakouts in this move over 47 sessions with a 39% gain already banked, and today would be the fourth push — the base sits well off the early-move lows with repeated visible pushes visible in the July–September price action. The RE check is a hard FAIL (burst bar is only 41% of the prior 5-bar range), meaning the signal bar itself lacks the expansion that defines a momentum burst. The prior breakouts worked only 1 of 4 times, reinforcing that this is a mature, tired move rather than a fresh one.
claude.key_risk: A fourth breakout attempt in a 60-session, 56% move with a sub-average burst bar and a 25% historical follow-through rate is a low-probability setup.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal day's high or if the first 30 minutes show price fading back below the prior close of 81.01.
